svg.title: 41. Bent knee lower trunk turn — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the mat. Keep your knees together and let both move slowly to one side. Keep both shoulders resting on the mat.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.worcsacute.nhs.uk/leaflets/stretching-exercises-physiotherapy/
